title: Design bundle manifest
description: docs/design/design.json: one manifest for the whole product's design bundle. screen-design writes it and updates it per feature; bundle.py audit fills the audit block from the files, and bundle.py gallery renders index.html from it. Screen keys are <feature>/<screen id> so ids from different flows files never collide.

product.description: Product name, as in tokens.json meta.name.

version.description: Bumped on every round that changes a screen, the sitemap or the navigation.

surface.description: web app, mobile app, or both.

audience.description: Who uses it, in one or two sentences; personas by role, not by name.

directions.description: The visual directions considered. Exactly one has chosen true; the others say why they lost.

stories.description: Every story id the bundle must serve. bundle.py adds the ids in each flows file's Serves column.

sitemap.description: The information architecture as a tree: sections hold children, leaves name a screen key.

desktop.description: The desktop chrome: side nav, top bar, what each holds.

mobile.description: The 375 px chrome: bottom tab bar items, back behaviour.

why.description: Why this navigation fits this product's depth and frequency of use.

source.description: The flows files whose navigation maps it was generated from.

purpose.description: One sentence: what the person gets done here.

concerns.description: What was raised while designing. A story no screen serves must appear here by id.

audit.description: Written by bundle.py audit, never by hand. null means the audit never ran, and bundle.py check fails on it.
